text: Jeep driver at Digboi main gate reversing without spotter, hit the ankle of a security guard who was directing traffic. Guard injured ankle badly, transported to hospital. Driver was a permanent employee, visibility was low due to smoke from nearby generator.

Hand got caught in flange gap while inserting new gasket on high pressure line. Bruising and abrasion sustained. Did not require hospitalization but medical certificate issued. Work stopped after incident for safety briefing.
Thermal cutting at Duliajan, debris flew out of containment. Hit leg of nearby worker. Abrasion and bruising, no fracture but required tetanus booster and dressing.
Residual pressure in small bore line released abrasive particles upon opening. Worker suffered corneal scratch in one eye. Treated with eye drops and monitored.

Operator missed critical alarm response due to drowsiness. Later found to be under influence of over-the-counter cold medicine mixed with alcohol. Experienced mild hypotensive episode treated at site health desk. Immediate removal from critical role and notification to HSSE coordinator. Recordable injury due to medical treatment for vitals stabilization.

Contractor crane operator at Digboi lifted a defective hydraulic valve with wire rope under tension, PTW expired, no spotter. Worker trapped hand in sheave, laceration required 12 stitches, sent to hospital.
Sling cut by sharp edge of valve flange at Moran, load shifted and pinned a fitter's hand against the block for 15 seconds before released; diagnosed with crushed fingers and swelling.

Small utility vehicle at Duliajan reversing into laydown area, struck a stack of pipe sections. One pipe rolled off, hitting maintenance worker in the calf. Worker required medical treatment for laceration and abrasions. Worker was not wearing safety boots compliant with ISO standards.

Lost flange bolts on 8" gas line led to separation of ends. Gas cloud formed rapidly around digging trench. Worker in trench had no egress under gas overpressure. Potential for explosion and burial. Gas detector alarm faulty.

Contractor crew installing cable tray at Naharkatiya. Anchor bolt sheared off during tensioning, 15kg bracket fell from 12m. Missed lead man by 1 meter, struck hard hat on ground. Witness saw bolt spinning down. No injury but high-energy object release near personnel.

Contractor found climbing 8m ladder without harness at Duliajan pump station. Scaffolding plank suddenly slipped from hands dropping tools below. Rescue team stopped work immediately, PTW cancelled. No falls recorded but high energy drop event.
Expired PTW for hot work found on Digboi plant 3, guard stopped welder before arc struck, sulfur smell detected nearby.
Vessel door at Duliajan unit left ajar during shift change, intern tried to enter for cleaning, stopped by supervisor who noted lack of LOTO verification. Potential for energy release existed.
During maintenance at Guwahati Depot, ventilation fan failed while two employees were inside the tank. Emergency exit used within 30 seconds. No respiratory distress reported but alarm triggered.
Jorhat Bypass Road: Truck crane operator failed to use tag line on tank assembly, load snagged on tree branch, no collision, near miss.
Lumding Terminal truck bay loading arm uncoupling. Seal ring ejected, fuel splash on apron but not on personnel. Driver remained inside cab, HSE officer verified zero contact. Near miss recorded
Ladder jackier slipped from anchor point while extending basket, harness caught the fall but impact was zero. Anchor point loose, site stopped. TBT training gap identified.
Overhead cable interference during boom rotation, lift paused, re-rigged with clearance check.
Rangia compressor pack-out revealed unisolated instrument air line. Whistle noise startled team. No injury, LOTO tag missing, corrective action initiated.

Fire during oxy-fuel cutting of pipe spur at Naharkatiya well pad, wind shift blew flame towards adjacent skid, PPE protected worker but handguard shattered, severe laceration to thumb requiring hospital admission, hand function compromised.
Contractor scaffold missing toe boards, worker stepped on loose plank, slid off edge, injured foot and lower back from impact.

Grinding sparks ignited flash vapour at Digboi tank farm, worker on night shift got 2nd degree burns on forearms treated at local clinic. Gas detector alarm triggered late due to faulty sensor calibration.
PTW issued without verifying zero energy state on pump. Mechanical seal blowout sprayed hot lube oil on technician. Heat burn treatment at site medical center.
Vehicle parked on shoulder with hazard lights off, pickup reversing, impact on leg, mid-shin fracture, splinted at site.
Forged LOTO tag discovered during audit. Worker was unscrewing valve when noticed. Small abrasion on finger from tool, cleaned and bandaged.
During lifting/suspended load at Digboi, a worker slipped and injured his wrist. Hospital check found no fracture; treated and released with medication.
Valve packed with wax, lever broken off during isolation. Contractor struck on head by falling lever, minor scalp abrasion, stitched at site.
During lifting/suspended load at Digboi, a worker slipped and injured his wrist. Hospital check found no fracture; treated and released with medication.

During scaffold erection at Lumding Terminal, a 3m steel tube slipped from 4th level while being passed. Worker standing below ducked, tube struck shoulder, soft tissue injury treated with ice and painkillers on site.
Fatigued operator speeding on curved section, skid hit barrier, mild shoulder dislocation, referred to Guwahati hospital.
Brazing coupling on Jorhat Bypass Road pipeline. Contractor used wrong filler rod, joint failed. Hot metal splatter burned hand. Blisters formed, antiseptic dressing and antibiotics prescribed.
Worker suffered thermal burn on face from leaking steam trap near tank entry point, skin blistered and treated with burn cream, required follow-up at specialist clinic.
Shackle pin ejected under high tension while hoisting pump section, pin struck shoulder of spotter, minor abrasion only but energy release sufficient for amputation if hand had been in path.

Cracked flange gasket under 200bar hydrostatic test pressure. Sudden leak created sonic boom and water hammer force. Worker in arc of projection, no injury but potential for eardrum rupture or blast trauma was real.

Ladder moved while employee ascending at Guwahati Depot. Slip at 1.5m, worker grasped railing too late. Hip impact with concrete wall. No fracture, bruising treated on site. Guardrail non-functional, LOTO bypassed.

Ladder foot lifted by forklift at Digboi storage unit. Worker at 3m lost balance, fell backwards. Hit steel beam on lower back. No fracture, severe pain. Forklift operator not briefed. Major near miss.
Load shifted during travel on uneven terrain, spool line dropped onto walking rigging crew, three workers jumped clear, one caught boot tip, potential severe crush injury averted.
Hot work permit expired while arc welding continued. Contractor unaware of time lapse. Supervisor noticed and halted job. No injury, but violation of PTW procedure noted.

Contractor team removing spade from 2-inch line near Digboi pump array. Gasket failure on re-assembly, minor hydrocarbon mist released. Bystander stepped back, no contact with fluid. Day shift clear sky
Welder near storage tank line, spark noticed popping from tank shell before PTW cancelled immediately, no fire started.
Contractor found unisolated line with residual pressure during maintenance at Duliajan. Valve was closed but PTW did not specify LOTO. No injury reported, line purged immediately.

Overnight security at Guwahati Depot consumed prohibited substance, leading to failure to challenge an unauthorized vehicle approaching storage tanks. Incident discovered at 0600 hrs when vehicle was already in restricted zone. No collision or intrusion, but clear breach of perimeter defense posed serious threat.
Welding scaffold near flare line, hot slag fell onto rain-soaked ground causing steam burst, workers evacuated safely.

Grinding near diesel tank dike produced continuous sparks. Nearby flammable liquid spill not cleaned up. Fire watch noticed glowing char on rag but no flame propagation. Risk assessed as high potential.

During night shift at Guwahati Depot, flange connection wept during pressure test. H2S alarm went off briefly. Response team arrived, secured area. No one injured, potential event logged as near miss.
Improper rigging angle caused the sling to slip off the drum, resulting in a free fall of 3 meters onto empty soil; PTW was valid but inspection was rushed.
Duliajan flare stack maintenance, tool dropped from 10 meters, hit platform edge, no one below, near miss for lower crew, tool contained, no injury.
PTW not cancelled after scope change at Guwahati Depot, fuel smell near electrical panel, near miss avoided due to static grounding kit nearby.
Residual H2S detected at Moran wellhead after TBT completion. Isolation flange not properly packed. Alert raised, area evacuated, no exposure recorded.
Contractor placed loose hand tool on elevated platform edge, swept off by wind, caught by barrier.
Bicycle with two children entered Jorhat Bypass Road near gate 4. Patrol jeep running high speed failed to stop in time. Impact lethal. Both children died at scene. Driver arrested.

Contractor welding on 6-inch carbon steel line at Duliajan gas plant during afternoon shift, gas detector failed to alarm near open hydrocarbon leak, worker suffered level 3 burn to face and neck, transported casualty to GHSP for treatment.
